# Oreste Utensils

> Oreste Utensils is a premium kitchenware brand and retailer based at City Plaza, Kigali, Rwanda. We sell exclusive, modern home and kitchen essentials and deliver across Kigali. Payment is made on delivery or at pickup (cash or MTN Mobile Money) — there is no online payment.

## Key facts

- **Business:** Oreste Utensils — premium kitchenware shop and retailer
- **Location:** City Plaza, Kigali, Rwanda
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +250 783 399 163
- **Opening hours:** Every day, 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/oreste_utensils/
- **Delivery:** Across Kigali. Free on orders over 500,000 RWF; otherwise a small fee confirmed on WhatsApp based on location. Free pickup at the City Plaza store.
- **Payment:** Cash or MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) on delivery or at pickup. No online payment required.
- **Currency:** Rwandan Franc (RWF)

## What we sell

- **Cookware** — dutch ovens, stainless woks, cast-iron cocottes, stovetop kettles, steamers
- **Dinnerware** — stoneware dinner sets, ceramic serving bowls, porcelain and stoneware mugs
- **Cutlery & Tools** — forged knife sets, silicone utensils, acacia chopping boards
- **Serveware & Glassware** — carafes, highball glasses, wine glasses, whiskey tumblers, serving trays
- **Storage & Organisation** — airtight glass jars, ceramic canister sets
- **Small Appliances** — countertop blenders, electric pressure cookers, drip coffee makers, burr grinders

## Common questions

- **Where can I buy kitchenware in Kigali?** At Oreste Utensils, City Plaza, Kigali — in store or delivered across the city.
- **Does Oreste Utensils deliver?** Yes, anywhere in Kigali. Free over 500,000 RWF.
- **How do I pay?** Cash or MoMo when your order arrives, or at the counter in store. No online payment.
- **How do I order?** Add items to the cart on the website and check out via WhatsApp, message +250 783 399 163 directly, or visit the store.
